header: Indicators: View specific infrastructure and evidence behind the threat (preview)
content:
the threat (preview)
The Indicators tab provides a list of all indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with the
threat. Microsoft researchers update these IOCs in real time as they find new evidence related
to the threat. This information helps your security operations center (SOC) and threat
intelligence analysts with remediation and proactive hunting. The list also retains expired IOCs,
so you can investigate past threats and understand their impact in your environment.
Threat analytics leverages and integrates various Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Security
Copilot features to keep you and your SOC team updated whenever a new report or new piece
of threat intelligence relevant to your environment becomes available.
